purpose: Mock simulation of how AI search systems would interpret the BROKEN golden site (pre-optimization). Expected: LOW across the board. After SEO-OS optimization, a re-run should rise substantially.

rationale.citationLikelihood: No citable summaries, no factual/numeric data, generic marketing copy, no FAQ -> almost nothing quotable.
rationale.entityClarity: Organization has no stable @id, no url/logo, no sameAs; dangling publisher @id; brand identity unverifiable.
rationale.llmExtractability: Multiple H1s, heading-level jumps, div-ish structure, no semantic article/section -> weak chunking.
rationale.knowledgeGraph: No llms.txt/ai-agents.json, broken @id graph, no Wikidata/sameAs -> not graph-ready.

ChatGPT Search.reason: No /llms.txt and no citation-ready paragraphs; would summarize generically without attributing this site.

Perplexity.reason: Prefers sources with clear facts + structure; thin content and broken schema make it a weak citation candidate.

Gemini.reason: Relies on Knowledge Graph/entity signals; missing Organization @id + sameAs + Google-Extended access uncertainty -> low trust.

Google AI Overviews.reason: No FAQPage/structured data, duplicate titles, missing descriptions -> unlikely to be surfaced as an Overview source.

expectedAfterOptimization.note: Targets if SEO-OS applies the baseline correctly (for delta validation).
